decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has shown proven value through UK Home Office use and connections to over 30 government APIs schemes, so uncertainty has largely resolved in its favour and it merits continued commitment rather than abandonment.

Demand for the travel health requirements API is uncertain now that pandemic-era rules have faded, but as a low-cost digital product with its own page and links to the firm's aviation document services it remains a cheap option worth holding a while longer.

The travel and document verification platform fits the firm's core airline and airport customers and its expanding digital portfolio, and it still has a dedicated page and low upkeep costs, so keeping the option open is justified while results emerge.
